recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future cleanup of the orphan relationship-types value set or example file names can be handled separately if build tooling owners want to prune unused source files; no current FHIR core semantic correction is needed for FHIR-10118.
issue_request: FHIR-10118 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for DSTU2 Observation asking to review Observation.related.type codes. The adopted breaking-change resolution replaced the generic Observation.related relationship-type model with direct elements, especially Observation.derivedFrom and the applied Observation.hasMember element, and used standard extensions for sequel-to and replaces.
initial_application: GF#10118 was applied by 2017 commits 5bdc6559670c09dbdcbfcdf5f716f84455c6e600 and 558e37577b4010855ad643cc7a9010fc9e665e17. The main commit disabled Observation.related, Observation.related.type, and Observation.related.target in the Observation spreadsheet, added Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom, and updated examples and notes. Current StructureDefinition source still carries #10118 committee notes on both explicit elements.
additional_context: Later model evolution explains differences from the old DSTU2 target list: Media was merged into DocumentReference, Sequence is now a removed resource, and later GenomicStudy/MolecularDefinition targets were removed with additional resources. Related reconcile commits already on the combined branch audited FHIR-14034 and fixed FHIR-13240 stale stats-operation wording. The old relationship-types value set file remains in the tree but is not referenced by active source/fhir.ini [valuesets], and the FHIR Extension Pack now carries observation-sequelTo and observation-replaces.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Active current Observation source defines Observation.hasMember and Observation.derivedFrom, current search parameters target those elements, and active narrative guidance no longer depends on a generic Observation.related relationship-code element.

related_jiras.note: Added Sequence as an Observation.related target before FHIR-10118 replaced the generic related model; left undecided because Sequence/genomic target evolution is a distinct target-resource audit.
Requested imaging references for derived Observations and is already represented on the combined branch with a no-change audit based on current Observation.derivedFrom.
Stats-operation wording was made stale by FHIR-10118 and is already represented on the combined branch with a source fix from .related/type to Observation.hasMember.
